scripts.validate:models: if [ -x .venv/bin/python ]; then .venv/bin/python -m mnist_playground validate static/models; else python3 -m mnist_playground validate static/models; fi
scripts.smoke:models: if [ -x .venv/bin/python ]; then PY=.venv/bin/python; else PY=python3; fi; $PY -m mnist_playground smoke static/models/cnn_small && $PY -m mnist_playground smoke static/models/cnn_good && $PY -m mnist_playground smoke static/models/cnn_freedraw_robust
